sessions.phase_label: Pre-award concept and initial subdivision planning
Detailed spatial design and iterative plan revisions
Final layout decisions and construction clarification

requirements.title: Three Independent Dwelling Subdivision
requirements.definition: Divide the existing floor into three independently usable dwelling units.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the number and independence of the resulting dwellings; individual room programs, entrances, kitchens, and bathrooms are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Unit 1 Two-Bedroom Program
requirements.definition: Configure Unit 1 as a 2+1 dwelling with two bedrooms and a living area.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers Unit 1's room-count program only; bathroom count, kitchen position, partitions, and circulation remain independently evolving behaviors.

requirements.title: Existing Wall Preservation Strategy
requirements.definition: Preserve existing interior walls wherever practical while identifying the limited walls to demolish or construct.
requirements.boundary_note: Represents the project-wide wall-retention constraint; target-specific wall movements serving a bathroom, kitchen, or corridor remain attributes of those spatial Requirements.

requirements.title: Unit 1 Kitchen and Common Bathroom Placement
requirements.definition: Determine the relative locations of Unit 1's kitchen and common bathroom, including whether their planned positions should be exchanged.
requirements.boundary_note: The proposed exchange is one coupled room-placement decision; cabinet details and bathroom fixture arrangements can change independently and are excluded.

requirements.title: Open-Plan Kitchen Cabinetry
requirements.definition: Provide each dwelling with kitchen cabinetry integrated into its living room rather than enclosed in a separate kitchen room, using the requested cabinet capacity.
requirements.boundary_note: Open-plan integration and the shared 180 cm upper/lower cabinet specification form one common cabinetry mechanism; unit-specific counter locations are separate.

requirements.title: Unit 3 Kitchen Counter Layout
requirements.definition: Position Unit 3's kitchen counter with adequate dimensions and clearance from the nearby bathroom door.
requirements.boundary_note: Unit 3's counter position can be revised independently of the common open-plan cabinetry specification and other units' kitchens.

requirements.title: Unit 1 Common Bathroom Layout
requirements.definition: Design Unit 1's non-en-suite bathroom, including its location, dimensions, door behavior, plumbing alignment, and fixture arrangement.
requirements.boundary_note: Excludes the separately evolving en-suite bathroom and the relative kitchen/common-bathroom room-placement decision.

requirements.title: Unit 1 En-Suite Bathroom
requirements.definition: Create and arrange a second independent bathroom connected to Unit 1's primary bedroom, with usable fixture and door placement.
requirements.boundary_note: The en-suite can be created, revised, or removed independently of Unit 1's common bathroom and therefore owns its own layout lifecycle.

requirements.title: Unit 2 Bathroom Layout
requirements.definition: Arrange Unit 2's bathroom door, toilet, and other bathroom elements with suitable access and existing-drain compatibility.
requirements.boundary_note: Unit 2's bathroom has its own door and plumbing decisions and should not be merged with the independently revised Unit 1 or Unit 3 bathrooms.

requirements.title: Unit 3 Bathroom Layout
requirements.definition: Design Unit 3's bathroom dimensions, door, shower, toilet, washing-machine placement, and drainage arrangement.
requirements.boundary_note: Unit 3 has an independent width, fixture-fit, and drain-routing trajectory, so it remains separate from the other bathrooms.

requirements.title: Retained Shared Main Entrance
requirements.definition: Retain the existing shared steel entrance door and connect the three dwelling entrances through the common internal access area.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the fixed building-level entrance and shared access relationship; each dwelling's private entrance door is a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Individual Steel Entrance Doors
requirements.definition: Provide every resulting dwelling with its own steel entrance door.
requirements.boundary_note: Private unit-door provision can change independently of the retained common building entrance and corridor-space allocation.

requirements.title: Common Corridor and Entrance-Area Allocation
requirements.definition: Avoid an unnecessarily wide common corridor and allocate entrance-area space through suitable partitions, room-wall shifts, or incorporation into Unit 1 while preserving usable door clearances.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers circulation width and allocation of shared entrance space; the general wall-preservation policy and entrance-door requirements remain separate.

requirements.title: Floor Plan Drawing
requirements.definition: Produce a floor-plan drawing showing the proposed dwelling division and principal bathroom, wall, and kitchen placements.
requirements.boundary_note: Represents the independently requested drawing artifact; its dimension annotations and optional furnished overlay are separate deliverable behaviors.

requirements.title: Plan Dimension Annotations
requirements.definition: Annotate the plan with requested room, wall, bathroom, fixture, door-width, and door-offset dimensions.
requirements.boundary_note: The requested measurements are attributes of one drawing-annotation deliverable rather than separate Requirements for every dimension.

requirements.title: Furnished Layout Drawing
requirements.definition: Provide a separate plan view showing representative furniture and appliances, including seating, televisions, beds, wardrobes, and refrigerators.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently requested visualization artifact, not a requirement governing the architectural room or cabinet locations themselves.

requirements.title: Exterior Window Retention
requirements.definition: Preserve the existing exterior facade windows in the proposed subdivision design.
requirements.boundary_note: Window preservation can be decided independently of whether the balcony is enclosed and is therefore a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Balcony Retention
requirements.definition: Keep the existing open balcony unchanged unless incorporating it into the adjacent room provides a meaningful design benefit.
requirements.boundary_note: Balcony enclosure is a distinct envelope and room-area decision rather than an attribute of exterior-window retention.

unresolved_candidates.description: Message 30 contains several alternative layout proposals, and the later generic approval does not safely identify which alternatives were accepted.

The client expects Unit 3 drainage compatibility, while the freelancer states that the actual WC drain connection must be resolved during construction; later evidence does not clearly settle the boundary of the drawing obligation.
The messages do not always explicitly distinguish Unit 1's common bathroom from its en-suite bathroom, so event routing for door and expansion decisions requires careful local-context review.

The final decision on exchanging Unit 1's kitchen and common bathroom remains unclear; the client's short acknowledgements can refer either to retaining the current layout or accepting the proposed exchange.
